people.name: Israel
people.line: Patriarch, son of Isaac, father of twelve tribes

translations.web: So Yahweh gave to Israel all the land which he swore to give to their fathers. They possessed it, and lived in it.
translations.bsb: Thus the LORD gave Israel all the land He had sworn to give their fathers, and they took possession of it and settled in it.
translations.kjv: And the LORD gave unto Israel all the land which he sware to give unto their fathers; and they possessed it, and dwelt
translations.asv: So Jehovah gave unto Israel all the land which he sware to give unto their fathers; and they possessed it, and dwelt therein.
